object_description: four articulated wings radiating around a central courtyard
design_condition: The radiating building addresses the full site perimeter, distributes access from multiple sides, and extends into a sequence of green and mineral intermediate spaces reaching rue du Parc.

positive.statement: The radiating device breaks up the imposing volume of the new college.
The spatial configuration favors multilateral access to the building.
The exterior developments skillfully continue the system through successive intermediate zones.
The ground-floor reference space effectively organizes the main public functions.
The spatial quality offered by the floor plan is undeniable.
The facades provide a unified reading of the college and express its institutional character.
The materialization gives the project a delicate and elegant character.

negative.statement: Typical classrooms facing the interior courtyard and entirely glazed create a usage problem for users.
The use of the passageways and the interior staircase did not convince the jury.
